Review comments at @packages/application/src/cloud/retry-pending-deletes.ts: - Line 21: Update the retry-pending-deletes flow so revisions with open ticket windows do not consume the retry limit: select eligible revisions before limiting results, or ensure pagination advances past skipped revisions. Preserve the existing ticketWindowClosed check and deletion behavior for eligible revisions. Review comments at @packages/domain/src/schemas/cloud-asset.ts: - Line 288: Update the timestamp validation in the cursor schema to reject millisecond values outside the range PostgreSQL’s timestamp driver can serialize, rather than only checking whether JavaScript considers the date valid. Preserve acceptance of timestamps within the supported range and ensure an out-of-range cursor is rejected during request validation.
